scope: Read-only external review of the Milestone 3 remediation specification/design package for Issues #61, #62 and #63 at base 3cf8358414a536f7411a183f6bc43fad05f1aad3 and head 749301030ad50a70e339a5d0b1ebba8ae3a681f3, including Issue #48, repository standards, M3 design documents and accepted remediation evidence.

findings.evidence: The claim-rule design requires an independent reviewer, complete-policy review and external review before approval/effectiveness. The pinned approval payload records reviewer_id=NhiBuaa and approved_by=NhiBuaa while asserting reviewer_was_author=false; the pinned source commit 82f8f5193b658310e73e9f2fb4abf13ebb954076 is authored by NhiBuaa. The fixed-point evidence envelope contains the approval/seal chain but no separate independent review record for this authority. Issue #48 also records that the remediation spec/design external-review gate was missing.
findings.problem: The effective claim-rule authority is backed by a self-attested identity assertion that is not independently evidenced and is inconsistent with the source commit author, while the design makes independent review a precondition of effectiveness.
findings.harm: A central fail-closed improvement gate can be treated as APPROVED_EFFECTIVE without proving the required independent review. This undermines the authority lifecycle and makes the claim decision evidence non-auditable under its own design.
findings.fix: Bind an actual independent-review artifact and reviewer identity to the authority seal/closure, verify the reviewer is not the authority author or approver as required by the policy, and reject an approval payload whose independence assertion cannot be proved. Re-run the authority and remediation cadence gates after the corrected chain is sealed.

checks.requirement: Issue #61 preserves the single production retrieval seam while making branch observations, provenance, public response validation, citation membership, latency and lexical observations explicit.
Issue #62 uses exclusive durable ownership with fencing, expiry/recovery, release and fail-closed readiness without changing the measured Q&A seam.
Issue #63 defines closed guardrails, typed paired provenance, exact metric decisions, taxonomy stages, public-only semantic input and authority-separated NO_CLAIM/SELECTED outcomes.
checks.evidence: GitHub Issue #63; docs/design/m3-improvement-claim-rule-v3.md; docs/design/m3-improvement-claim-rule-v1.policy.json; .agents/manual-tests/m3-remediation-issue-63-v6.md. The policy is internally coherent, but its required independent-review precondition is not evidenced by the pinned authority chain.

checks.requirement: The remediation mapping and dependency direction are consistent with Issue #48: #61 and #62 are prerequisites for #63.
checks.evidence: GitHub Issue #48 comments and the authoritative Issue #61/#62/#63 bodies; docs/design/m3-evaluation-environment-binding-v3.md; docs/design/m3-evaluation-sealed-environment-v2.md.
